svg.title: Questions to ask every hearing clinic before comparing a quote
svg.desc: A question grid, not a score. No channel is rated. Ask whether the price is itemized, whether the trial is in writing, who pays for follow-ups, and who owns the clinic.
svg.text: Ask every channel the same four things
Qualitative only. No score, no price, and no ranking of Costco or any clinic.
1. Is the aid priced apart from the visits, or folded into one number?
2. What is the trial, in writing, and what do you pay if you return the aids?
3. Which follow-ups and repairs are included, and for how many years?
4. Is the seller registered for the public program, and who owns the clinic?

text.tspan: Alberta AADL states a minimum 28-day trial. One Costco.ca product page stated a 3-year repair warranty and

svg.text: Those two facts are not a score for every warehouse club or every independent clinic.
Saving Optimizer, 27 Sep 2026. Write the answers on the quote. Do not invent a winner.
